address: Intercontinental Khao Yai Resort 262 Mu 6, Pong Talong, Pak Chong, Nakhon Ratchasima, 30450, Thailand
bio: Housed in a beautifully restored railway carriage within the resort's lush grounds, this stunning dining spot with lakeside tables is inspired by the Orient Express. Open in the evenings only, it serves both an à la carte and a changing set menu featuring premium ingredients and a classic European touch, channelling the golden age of rail travel. The bœuf filet mignon with red wine jus, sautéed vegetables and mash is a signature – elegant, comforting and full of old-world charm....
